subject: project-nereid
label: Three wrong heads, one missing column
from: THREE SEPARATE HAIR ERRORS filed as three separate acts of carelessness
to: ONE STRUCTURAL HOLE, THREE TIMES. THERE IS NO HAIR FIELD IN THE GIRL SCHEMA.
note:
FIFTEEN FIELDS PER ROW: id, name, nickname, epithets, partner, arc, house, two build classes, height, measurements, cock, flight, occupation, blurb. NO HAIR. Hair exists in this Archive only where somebody happened to write it into a paragraph, which means it is unindexed, unqueryable and invisible to every verifier.

THE THREE ERRORS WERE ALL THE SAME ERROR. Bella written black instead of STEEL-GREY AND CHERRY-RED. Bryn written dark-blonde instead of PLATINUM WITH VIOLET. Torie written dark instead of PLUM-WINE RED WITH VIOLET. Each time the Archive reached for a slot the schema does not contain and filled it from nothing.

AND PILLAR FIVE OF NEREID v8 IS HAIR — colour, length and personality, granted a temperament of its own. The canon treats hair as one fifth of the body and the data model does not treat it as a field at all. THIS IS THE STRONGEST ARGUMENT YET FOR THE v8 PROFILE MIGRATION.

TWO HEADS FILED TODAY AS A DOWN PAYMENT: Lucia, burnt honey with crimson, a lion’s mane. Siren, wine red with silver, mid-back waves.
